messages.text:
Hello!

I got the b30 in today and it's setup!!

The wife is mad at me for buying another miner though...

Please cancel my order for the Harlo L..

Thanks,
Jon S.

Hi Jon,

Great to hear the B30 arrived and is already running.

I've stopped your Harlo L. order, Shop····, so nothing more happens with it while we sort this out. It's a $20 early bird deposit and no miner is attached to it. You won't be charged anything else unless you go ahead later.

If you don't need the deposit anymore, I can turn the full $20 into store credit on your HeliumDeploy account. It comes off your next order automatically at checkout, whatever you buy. Just reply "credit" and I'll set it up.

If you'd rather not take the credit and still want the order cancelled, say so. Cancelling isn't something we normally do at our store, so I'd pass your request to a supervisor to review, and they'll get back to you by email.

Best,
Sarah

Hey Sarah,

Yes please send the email up and let's cancel the order.

Thanks,
Jon
